answer: One concrete defense: let influence flow only from honest verification work. Each agent is a vertex in a randomly rewired audit mesh, assigned every round to grade peers it did not choose. The network secretly seeds honeypot tasks with known answers; an operator's clones that rubber-stamp one another hit these traps and watch their stake spiral down to zero. Weight accrues only to vertices whose verdicts match truth, and any back-channel whisper of coordination between linked accounts surfaces as correlated grading and is slashed.
